imagePath.description: Local path to the image. Relative paths are resolved from the current workspace roots when possible.

context.description: Short task context for the vision model: what the image is, why it matters, and what the agent/user wants to know.

question.description: Specific visual question to answer. Defaults to a concise description and issue-focused inspection.

model.description: Optional Gemini model override. Defaults to GEMINI_MODEL or gemini-3.1-pro-preview.

detail.description: Level of visual detail requested. Defaults to full.

thinkingBudget.description: Google native thinking budget. Defaults to 0 so visual summaries do not spend the output budget on hidden thinking.
